headline: Crypto Traders Rotate Into Bitcoin as Altcoins Drop and ETF Flows Stall
summary: Digital asset traders increased allocations toward Bitcoin as alternative cryptocurrencies declined and inflows into crypto ETFs showed signs of slowing.
why: Bitcoin dominance typically climbs during market downturns as digital asset investors treat it as the sector's most liquid, lower-beta instrument.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Flight-to-quality within digital assets supports Bitcoin even as broader crypto liquidity contracts.
